description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans serialization, specifically testing polymorphic serialization, exception serialization, object copying, and type hierarchies using the Xunit testing framework. It defines custom exception classes and several data classes with inheritance, along with test cases to verify correct serialization and deserialization behavior.

classes.name: CustomException
classes.description: A custom exception class supporting serialization with additional integer data.

classes.name: PolymorphismTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests verifying polymorphic serialization behavior, exception handling, and object copying within Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: SomeBaseClass
classes.description: Base class with string and integer properties, used to test inheritance serialization.

classes.name: SomeSubClass
classes.description: Derived class from SomeBaseClass adding additional string and integer properties.

classes.name: OtherSubClass
classes.description: Another derived class from SomeBaseClass with different properties, used in polymorphism tests.

classes.name: SomeSubClassChild
classes.description: Subclass of SomeSubClass with additional properties for more complex inheritance structure.

methods.name: ExceptionsAreSerializable
methods.description: Test method verifying serialization, deserialization, and deep copying of different exception types, including custom exceptions.

methods.name: GeneratedSerializersRoundTripThroughSerializer_Polymorphic
methods.description: Test verifying round-trip serialization/deserialization of a polymorphic object.

methods.name: GeneratedSerializersRoundTripThroughSerializer_PolymorphicMultiHierarchy
methods.description: Test verifying serialization/deserialization across multiple inheritance hierarchies for different derived classes.

methods.name: DeepCopyPolymorphicTypes
methods.description: Test method for verifying deep copying of polymorphic objects maintains data correctness.

methods.name: RoundTripToExpectedType
methods.description: Helper method to serialize an object and deserialize it back, casting to expected type.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Helper method to perform deep copying of an object via serializer.
